title: The Secret Semester
author: G. M. Vasquez
blurb: Gideon Ravensworth, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
